mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which boosts long-term equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers increased consumer and business confidence, driving corporate earnings growth and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite UNRATE falling below 4.5% in the same period, or the effect's p-value > 0.05 in 30% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic activity, reducing uncertainty and driving equity price appreciation over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are negative despite simultaneous growth in GDPC1 and HOUST, or the interaction's IC < 1.96 in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected rise in the federal funds rate above historical averages signals stronger policy tightening, which compresses growth expectations and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in a 'monetary tightening cycle', or the effect's t-statistic < 1.96 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a tightening cycle signals controlled economic growth, reducing risk premium pressures and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite simultaneous FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL decline, or the interaction's IC < 0.05 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in labor participation (PAYEMS) above 65,000 signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite PAYEMS exceeding 65,000 in the same month, or the effect's p-value > 0.05 in 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicates a balanced and robust economy, reducing uncertainty and driving equity price increases over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite simultaneous growth in GDPC1 and INDPRO, or the interaction's IC < 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals momentum in the labor market, fostering investor optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite UNRATE falling in a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, or the effect's t-statistic < 1.96 in 40% of instances.
